node: Data-center power, grid interconnection, electrical equipment and liquid cooling
summary: Expanded the AI data-center power/cooling universe beyond the seed list toward smaller but still mostly >$1B US-listed suppliers tied to medium-voltage distribution, substation/grid equipment, enclosures, liquid/air cooling, and electrical/mechanical construction capacity. The highest-relevance additions are Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and electrical power distribution systems, Hubbell for utility/substation and grid-resiliency equipment, nVent for data-center enclosures, power/data connection and liquid/air cooling, Modine for data-center cooling products, and Comfort Systems USA for mechanical/electrical installation capacity in data-center construction. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
